state.objective: Configure PodDisruptionBudget for critical search-indexing cluster.

context.content: Deployment replicas: 5; node upgrades drain 1 node at a time.
Image: elasticsearch:8.11.2 with custom synonyms plugin.

submitted_answer.answer: Configure a PodDisruptionBudget with maxUnavailable set to 1, preserving at least 4 of 5 replicas during voluntary disruptions.
